notes.title: 6/5/2024 Small Patch
notes.notes:
New Feature: Single-player mode now has tactical commands for nearby AI.
Refactor:
Modernized replay mode with time bar dragging and multiplayer recording.
Overhauled commander mode for free perspective vehicle commands; vehicle state preserved on exit.
Revamped vehicle control logic and track system; optimized aerial bomb physics.
Redesigned historical battle mode for easier vehicle selection and faction switching.
Optimization:
AI now counterattacks out-of-sight enemies; improved attack logic.
Enhanced resource loading logic.
Fix: Resolved unresponsive perspective dragging issue.
Update by WINDYVERSE PTE. LTD.

notes.notes:
1. Fix the issue where the workshop logic continues to run after exiting the workshop.

notes.title: 2023/4/2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
This is a major update

1. Added equivalent thickness for internal modules
2. Added grassland option to map workshop terrain
3. Refactored the Lua-based scripting system for easier customization of gameplay; installation of Lua mods is the same as standard mods. For Lua scripting, please refer to: https://www.yuque.com/chaojiduolajiang/panzerwar/bpig0t
4. Added category search in the workshop
5. Editable turret rotation speed in tank workshop module mode
6. Fixed discrepancies between garage armor monitor display and actual impact angles
First-party content updates:

1. Added Japanese-style combinations to DIY maps
2. Added grassland display to spring terrain
Third-party content updates:
1. Numerous content updates, including vehicle balance adjustments, module optimization, and more.

This update was made possible by the collaborative efforts o 7500K的灯， gjc133 ， Zero， erhddty ，开坦克的雪风酱 .

notes.title: The update 1.03 has come.
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/4790a8624a71cea6ce74cea85ac3911cd4133b92.jpg
New Tank!

One new WW2 tank, Char Bis 1, has been added to the game. It features with 75 mm main gun and 37 mm main gun on its turret. Of course, both of the guns can shoot in the game.
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/240d02f8609d0aa3c4bd9e02cd248cf49306b332.jpg
New Mode
What’s more, a new game mode “Historical Template-based mode” is added to Cry of War.

In Cry of War, you can set your nation, and the range of vehicle you can select will be limited due to your nation. And that is a non-respawn game mode.
 



As to the Panzer War, the new game mode RTS mode has joined the desktop version.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/8d2801f87c475b0cff6a0c50abacada3713f4285.jpg
The control of RTS mode: (The tutorial has not been added to the game now. So look at the following control guidance)


 W A S D to move the camera. Q E to rotate the camera.
 Left mouse: click to select a single unit.
 Drag mouse with holding the left mouse to draw a selection box to select units
 Right mouse: click to attack the enemy
 Drag mouse with holding the right mouse to draw an arrow for where the selected units look for.
 Hold left ctrl and left click on the map to attack any place on the map.


A new mission called “Fury” is added to the Panzer War.
In this mission, you will be the commander of four Sherman tanks and you will encounter the Tiger.
 

Also, a new game mode “Historical Template-based mode” is added to Panzer War. It is an RTS game mode. The goal in this mode is to destroy all enemy units.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32080170/b99040a32d9060e2161fffc54c98e210348a6f9b.jpg

Update and Enjoy it now! And share the news of the game update to your friends.
